notes: Round hamster with short limbs. Spanish bone names (Caderas = hips, Torso_bajo/alto = lower/upper torso, Cuello = neck, Cabeza = head, brazo = arm, palma = palm, pulgar/indice/medio/anular/menique = fingers, pierna = leg, pie = foot). The source arms and legs were single bones parented to the root; they were re-parented to the torso/hips and split in two (brazo -> antebrazo, pierna -> pierna_lower) with weights blended along the bone so every limb has upper/lower segments. Full 5-finger hands. Ears are small and have no bones. Facing +Z (glTF/Godot), +Y up, metres; soles at y=0, centred between the feet. Top of skull at y=0.800 (ears/hats excluded), crown point (x -0.000, y 0.800, z -0.080); head width 0.355 m, depth 0.327 m; head bone origin at (x 0.000, y 0.566, z -0.093). Rest pose T (upper arm -1 deg below horizontal). 45 bones, 3124 triangles. Bone local axes follow Blender's convention (+Y along each bone towards its child).
